governingPrinciple: Strict Single Source of Truth (SSOT). Subsystems have mutually exclusive domain authority. Host UI is strictly a projection view.

nativeHost.domain: Operating System, Hardware I/O, Windowing & Process Lifetime

exclusiveResponsibilities.description: Enumerates, tracks, and bounds the target game client window (htgame.exe / 异环).
Detects active window focus via SetWinEventHook; emits authoritative FOCUS_LOST / FOCUS_GAINED signals.
Intercepts global mouse/keyboard events on dedicated Win32 thread; enforces SSOT active scan freeze.
Controls frame capture clock, assigns monotonic sequence numbers, timestamps acquisition in nanoseconds.
Spawns, monitors, and restarts child Python process; manages Named Pipe and MMF lifetime.
Authoritatively advertises available Win32 and Direct3D capabilities.

prohibitions: Host SHALL NOT arbitrate item identity, canonical item names, or catalog ID mappings.
Host SHALL NOT calculate valuation distributions, price estimates, or profit margins.
Host SHALL NOT create, mutate, or finalize MatchRecord v7 or draft records.
Host SHALL NOT determine winner attribution or auction resolution.

pythonEngine.domain: Computer Vision, Domain Semantics, Valuation Mathematics & Canonical State

exclusiveResponsibilities.description: Holds the sole in-memory authority for current match lifecycle (DRAFT -> FINALIZED), zero ghost drafts, and field status.
Manages permanent match persistence, manifest checksums, export zip creation, and audit trails.
Arbitrates resolve_local_identity, 214-item catalog, verified source card registry, and same-ID conflict rules.
Executes six-quality joint valuation model, historical shadow algorithms, and sell-all profit optimizations.
Parses raw text tokens into structured bids, seller seats, winner roster, and free intel chains.
Evaluates final transaction receipts and resolves winner identity against local player profile.

prohibitions: Python SHALL NOT directly invoke Win32 EnumWindows or SetWindowsHookEx in production.
Python SHALL NOT directly manage OS HWND placement or DirectComposition transparency.
Python SHALL NOT directly inject hardware SendInput events without Host TOCTOU verification.

rules: Host UI overlay is strictly a read-only projection view of CurrentMatch and PerceptionResult.
Host UI SHALL NOT maintain an independent business truth state.
User clicks, button toggles, or hotkeys in the UI are emitted to Python Engine as COMMAND intent messages with unique commandId.
Host UI SHALL NOT declare a match finalized or item identified until authoritative Python confirmation is received.
If a disconnection occurs, Host UI renders a 'Reconnecting...' state projection without discarding active HUD layout.

conflictResolutionPolicy: In any scenario where Host UI projection contradicts Python Engine state, Python Engine state is the immutable Single Source of Truth. Host UI must re-sync via STATE_SNAPSHOT.
